meaningful_proposed_additions.proposed_question: How does the illustrated Eurasian Lynx’s Iconic Animal: Europe ability calculate its appeal reward, and whose Europe icons count?
meaningful_proposed_additions.expected_answer: When the animal is played, gain 1 appeal for each Europe icon in all zoos combined, including your own zoo, up to a maximum of 8 appeal from this ability. Its own Europe icon counts under the normal self-counting rule.
material_new_facts: This is an immediate aggregate over all players’ zoos, rather than just the owner’s zoo or a reward for future icon plays.
The illustrated aggregate awards 1 appeal per Europe icon, capped at 8.
existing_context_not_new_novelty: Q30 already establishes self-counting and eligible icon locations.
Q34 defines any zoo; Q68/Q89 cover recurring triggers when an icon is played in any zoo.
meaningful_proposed_additions.why_distinct: No active question requests the printed immediate all-zoos aggregate with a cap. Defining any zoo is not a question about this aggregate outcome. The difference is aggregation scope and on-play calculation, not changing Europe to another continent or substituting a numerical X.
